simple.meaning: מָאֵן (mâʼên) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to refuse.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 41 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 37:35. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, firstborn.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָאֵן (H3985).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מָאֵן (mâʼên) / H3985 is traced through Genesis 37:35, Genesis 39:8, Genesis 48:19, Exodus 4:23 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H3985. maen [ מָאֵן verb Pi`el refuse ( Qal perhaps be distasteful , compare Syr, taeduit, piguit , Aph`el be slothful ; Late Hebrew Pi`el, as term, techn. of girl, refuse to acknowledge marriage contract; possibly akin to Ethiopic reject ; Arabic is sustain, maintain ); — Pi`el Perfect מֵאֵן Exod 7:14 4 t.; feminine singular מֵאֲנָה Jer 15:18 3 t.; מֵאַנְתָּ Exod 10:3 , etc.; Imperfect יְמָאֵן 22:16 ; וַיְמָאֵן Gen 37:35 8 t. etc.; Inf. abs מָאֵן Exod 22:16 ; — refuse , (followed by Infinitive except 6 t. see below) human subject Gen 37:35 (J), Jer 31:15 ; Exod 22:17 (twice in verse); Num 20:21 ; 22:14 (all E), Deut 25:7 ; 1Sam 8:19 ; 2Sam 2:23 ; 13:9 ; 1Kin 20:35 ; 21:15 ; Est 1:12 ; Jer 50:33 compare Job 6:7 ; Psa 77:3 ; Prov 21:25 ; Jer 15:18 ; without Infinitive וַיּאֹמֶר וַיְמָאֵן Gen 39:8 ; 48:19 (both J), 1Sam 28:23 ;; also 2Kin 5:16 ; especially of refusing to obey ׳י 's commands Exod 4:23 ; 7:14 ; 10:3 ; 16:28 (all J), Neh 9:17 ; also Psa 78:10 ; Prov 21:7 ; Hosea 11:5 , see especially Jer 3:3 ; 5:3 (twice in verse); 8:5 ; 9:5 ; 11:10 ; compare 25:28 ; Zech 7:11 ; without Infinitive = be recusant Prov 1:24 ; Isa 1:20 once subject ׳י Num 22:13 (E).
